nom: Paula's Choice RESIST Intensive Wrinkle-Repair Retinol

avis.texte: Excellent product, I combine this (two pumps) with a Hyaluronic Acid Serum (two to three drops) I buy here on Amazon and the combo of these two products makes my skin look like I'm young and fresh. Which says a lot ... I'm in my 40's and have all the signs of aging skin. If I use this product without a hyaluronic acid serum I do NOT get the same results. Why? Who knows. I'm not a chem major so I can't tell you why the combo of those 2 products gives me such great results, I just know that it does. That said, paying $70 for this is a CRIME!! Go directly to Paula's Choice site and buy from them; the product is $37 there. As for which hyaluronic acid I use, it's called "The Original Hyaluronic Acid Serum 100% Pure" by Timeless Skin Care. You can buy it here on Amazon for less than $14 ... it will last you a long time. UPDATE: JUNE 2014. The seller came down with their price and offer Prime members free shipping. SOLD!!! I now buy this product here on Amazon from this seller. THANK YOU for reading the reviews and adjusting your price. :-)

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling great, lots of high-quality ingredients for thecprice
avis.texte: Been using it for years as suggested on the product, I apply it at night after their BHA and follow with their moisturizer. This routine leaves my middle-age skin comfortable and smooth in the morning. When I fail to use it my face & neck feels more dry, less comfortable. They claim it reduces/prevents age damage...I have no idea if that is true. I'm the wrong client to adk, because I don’t track the changes on my skin over time very carefully. I don't have severe wrinkling or dryness, because my skin was oily and acne-prone in my youth. For me, using Paula's Choice products is about the feel of my skin for the price, not the appearance of my skin. Paula's choice contains more high-quality ingredients and less perfume per dollar than comparable high-quality products, and leaves my skin feeling as good or better than more heavily marketed or perfumey brands. To compare what my skin would look like without Paula's Choice, I look at pictures on my mom at my age. No difference! Her skin looked great, and still looks great for 94, LOL! She didn’t have the benefit of this stuff, but told me, and I listened, to always wear a hat when outdoors, and never sunbathe, but instead to be active outdoors while protecting your skin from direct sunlight. My mom now uses this, too, and she agrees, skin products of today that utilize vitamin C, retinols, BHA, etc., do leave your skin feeling better with consistent use than the ones she used back when. And that's worth paying a bit more for. On

avis.titre: Oily, but absorbs quickly and feels wonderful!
avis.texte: I've used this product for several months and I love it. I began using it at night, because it is an oil and didn't want a greasy feeling during the day or under make-up. I have to say, the RESIST does go on oily, but - at least on my skin - it absorbs rather quickly and does NOT leave a greasy feeling after just a few minutes. My skin is 55 years old (just my skin, because I'm sure the rest of me is not nearly that old!) so use the oil on my face, neck and upper chest areas. I am no beauty, so I really don't know if this product works as a beauty enhancement, but it feels so GOOD on my skin, that I really recommend using it regularly. I just wish I had started taking care of my skin much younger. I now use the RESIST every evening and occasionally in the morning, as well.

avis.titre: Retinol for Beginners – Gentle Yet Effective
avis.texte: This serum's oily texture spreads easily over the skin, making application smooth and effortless. A little goes a long way, making it quite economical. I incorporated it into my nighttime skincare routine and found it to be a great addition. My skin is sensitive, but I didn’t experience any irritation with this product, which is a big plus. Over time, I noticed that my skin became smoother and firmer, with a more refined texture. The manufacturer describes this serum as intensive, and while it does deliver visible results, I’d say it’s more suitable for women in their 30s as an introduction to retinol. I used this serum as a preparatory step before transitioning to a more concentrated retinol product from the same brand. It’s a great choice for those new to retinol or for those looking for a gentle yet effective anti-aging treatment. If you're just starting with retinol or have sensitive skin, this serum is a safe and effective way to incorporate it into your routine.

avis.titre: This Retinol is an absolute game changer

In just a short time, I’ve seen a remarkable improvement in the appearance of my large pores and oily skin, plus it’s worked wonders on my fine lines. I can’t recommend it enough!

avis.titre: Great product for mature dry skin.
avis.texte: I have tried this product twice and find it a good hydrating product for my aged dehydrated skin. I would recommend it, as it gives your skin a deep moisturising leaving it with a better look through the day.

I adore this product which I used as a step up to Paula's Choice 1% Clinical Retinol treatment and more recently a 0.25 Tretinoin. I'm unable to use Tretinoin or the 1% Clinical on my throat without a bad reaction so use this with no reaction whatsoever. It is quite expensive but worth it I think.

avis.titre: Es wirkt und fühlt sich gut an
avis.texte: Ich hab schon lange mit Retinol geliebäugelt, war aber skeptisch, ob meine manchmal etwas komplizierte Haut damit umgehen kann. Das Serum benutze ich nun jeden Tag. Es ist nicht so hoch dosiert, daher habe ich mich als Einsteiger daran getraut. Ich bin bisher super zufrieden. Es fühlt sich auf der Haut ganz seidig an und am nächsten Tag fühlt sich die Haut praller an und sieht weniger faltig aus.
Woohoo! I love this product! Results are amazing! Be sure to wear spf everyday!

So I'm new to retinol and have been using this for a little over a week. Been getting some retinol burn, which I read is a normal side effect. I follow with a retinol based cream. But I get a reaction from this within 15 mins of use. It takes a little time to permeate your skin and dry off. I already see some improvement in my forehead wrinkles and 11s. Though slight, they appear less pronounced

avis.titre: Amazing stuff! My skin has never looked better! No issues with pump. Read on...
avis.texte: Get this directly from PaulasChoice.com if you have concerns you are not getting it directly from them. Amazing customer service! I have had no issues with packaging or the pump. I use this daily without fail and am so impressed with the results. I am one of those people who has bought just about every wrinkle item available. I have a drawer full of junk that didn't work. This worked! I thought the price was decent for the amount you get. I only use one pump and it covers my whole face, neck and chest. Try this with the 2% BHA. That gets the dead skin cells off your face so you can get this product on fresh skin. I have not been disappointed at all. And I am one of the worse skeptics. I go directly to the 1 star reviews and read the negative before purchasing anything! I am so blown away by how well this works. Hope my review helps.

I was so excited when I read all the reviews for this Serum. My skin always soaks up product, I normally use a foam wash, then antiwrinkle Serum, then a moisturizer. When I received my order I replaced the strivectin with the Paula's choice, it came out of the bottle feeling like straight oil, I put it on my face, and no matter how much I rubbed it just sat on my face, I felt like I was rubbing vegetable oil all over. I patted off the excess thinking maybe it will absorb overnight. When I woke up in the am, my skin was still so greasy, I used my face wash to take it off, and I had to wash a second time to get it all off. Mind you it says use 1-2 squirts of the product, so glad I only used one. I had high hopes for this because of the reviews, but, I was completely disappointed.
